# Discovery preview snapshot

`subjects.json` and the corresponding cover JPEGs were fetched from
`https://next.bgm.tv/p1/trending/subjects?type=2&limit=6&offset=0`
on 2026-10-12. The covers are matched by subject ID.

These fixtures make the real discovery page previews reproducible without
network access. They are presentation samples, not a built-in trending list.
